newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sanitary ware losses hit Sphinx results.
newsitem.headline: Sanitary ware losses hit Sphinx results.

text.p: Sanitary ware maker NV Koninklijke Sphinx Gustavsberg said on Wednesday 1996/97 losses had widened due to losses at its ceramic sanitary ware division and restructuring charges.
The company earlier reported a full-year loss of 45.1 million guilders compared with a year-earlier 33.1 million, partly due to a 30.0 million guilder restructuring charge.

It said that while the majority of group companies ended the year in profit, ceramic sanitary ware plunged to a 15.1 million guilder operating loss from a year-earlier profit of 9.3 million as a difficult market pressured margins.
Net sales for the division rose by 2.5 percent to 342.9 million guilders, as volume growth at its Dutch and Swedish units compensated for lower sales in Belgium and Germany.
It said falling prices had particularly affected Deutsche Sphinx Sanitar and Novoboch and Warneton in Belgium.

Sphinx Gustavsberg said its showers and baths activities saw operating profits fall by 5.8 percent to 14.6 million guilders, while sales were also down due to a changed product mix which incorporated new, cheaper series.
Special Products boosted operating profits by 8.8 percent to 12.4 million guilders.
Net sales at the Special Products division jumped by 20 percent to 273.7 million guilders.
